lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Guests are arriving down the lane!

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Can you smell the berry pies cooling?

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Glad we finished the harvest in time.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: I was disqualified from the pie contest.

lines.speaker: organizer
lines.text: You ate three of your own entries before judging.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Quality control is a thankless duty.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: What a feast they laid out!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Save some energy for the square dance.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Music is starting by the fires!

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: The traveling minstrel challenged a goat to a duet.

lines.speaker: visitor
lines.text: Who won?

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: The goat had better tempo.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Raise a cup to the settlement!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Best harvest we've had in years.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: The banner looks great up there.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Visitors everywhere in the square.

lines.speaker: visitor
lines.text: We walked three days to catch this fair.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: Grab a plate before the stew runs dry.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: I entered my turnip in the harvest contest.

lines.speaker: judge
lines.text: It is suspiciously round.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: At last, a vegetable that understands presentation.
